data_deps.name: torchreid_market1501_full
data_deps.description: Complete official Market-1501: all 751 train identities and 12,936 training images, all 3,368 official query images, and the complete 19,732-image gallery including junk distractors. The verifier authenticates every JPEG and an ImageNet-pretrained torchvision ResNet-50 checkpoint by SHA-256 before running the fixed 60-epoch P x K protocol. All assets are staged in one pinned offline repo image.
